heading: Reach out
intro: Questions about coaching, the group sessions, prayer requests, or anything else — this reaches me directly. I answer every message, usually within a couple of days.
crisisHeading: If you need help right now
crisisBody: This form is not monitored around the clock, and it is not a crisis service. If you are in immediate danger, call 911. The National Domestic Violence Hotline is free, confidential, and available 24 hours a day at 1-800-799-7233, or text START to 88788. The 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline is available by call or text at 988.
